contradictions: Funded Engineer: JJ's $1.6M video (July 2026) credits ~$180,000 of payouts to 'Funded Engineer', but Funded Engineer (Dubai, FX prop firm) filed for bankruptcy on 15 July 2024 after FPFX revoked its licence in Feb 2024, and JJ's trading career began ~early 2025. Either the firm name in the video/transcript is misheard (candidates: Funded Futures Network/'FFN', 'FFF', 'Funding Futures'), or the payouts are from an unrelated entity. Unresolved.

Trades per day: his own videos and transcripts say ~10 trades/day in the NY session; the Chart Fanatics episode title says 30 trades/day; prior knowledge says 10-30. Likely 10 per session across up to 3-4 sessions, but not confirmed.

Per-firm totals in the $1.6M video sum to about $1.15M (Topstep 292k + E8 222k + FE 180k + MFF 92k + FundedNext 129.5k + Lucid 105k + Alpha 75k + Bulwark 55k), leaving ~$450k attributed to other firms (Tradeify etc.) that the available snippets did not itemize.
Bios lag each other: at the same time (Oct 2026) YouTube says $2,000,000+, TikTok says $1,800,000+, X says $1,500,000+ (older: $1,300,000), Instagram says $1,500,000.
Income promise differs by platform: Instagram 'scale to $10K+/month' vs YouTube/TikTok 'scale to $30K+/month'.
365-day third-party backtest is reported two ways: +51.89% / PF 1.94 / 56.69% WR (sozai transcript) vs 49% / PF 1.7 / 55% WR (another summary of the same video); the un-optimized version had PF ~1.2.

Copy trading: JJ says he trades accounts one at a time and only occasionally copies two, and advises against copiers until ~$20k earned, while a third-party summary says the method 'teaches traders to use trade copiers across dozens of smaller funded accounts'.
Mentorship pricing: official funnel shows a $49/month community tier with 1-on-1 priced after application, while pirated resellers claim an 'original price' of $6,500 or $6,000.

Timeline arithmetic: '$1.2M in 12-13 months' and '$1.5M at 16 months' are consistent with a start ~Feb 2025, but '$2M+' by Sept 2026 implies ~$500k in roughly 3 months (June-Sept 2026), i.e. a sharp acceleration that is not itemized in any snippet found.
Trading Nut podcast: one search snippet implied a 'JJ' appearing on Trading Nut; this could not be tied to JJ Simon and is treated as unverified.
